FROM users u
LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id
LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = u.department_id AND d.company_id = u.company_id
LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.company_id = u.company_id
